newsitem.title: DUBAI: TENNIS-MUSTER OVERCOMES FOOT INJURY TO ADVANCE.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-MUSTER OVERCOMES FOOT INJURY TO ADVANCE.

text.p: Second seed Thomas Muster of Austria overcame a foot injury to move into the second round of the Dubai Open with a straight sets victory over Swedish qualifier Tomas Nydahl on Tuesday.
Muster, world ranked number three, received attention for a sore left foot late in the second set but survived the scare to win 6-4 6-3.
"I am still hungry for success and that's what keeps me going," said 29-year-old Muster, after his first victory in three attempts against his 152nd ranked opponent.
Spanish baseliner Javier Sanchez was forced to sweat it out against Sweden's Lars Jonsson, winning 6-4 6-7 6-2.
After an early exchange of breaks, Sanchez, ranked 35 in the world, broke again for a 5-4 lead and served out the first set.
Jonsson, ranked 133, levelled the match after dropping only two points in the second set tie-breaker, but Sanchez regained his momentum to dominate the third set and take the match.
